name: dance_floor
description: Five takes over four minutes on a dance floor, eleven seconds between takes.
why: Section 10.1's 'a 5-minute dance sequence becomes multiple moments'. The room, the light and the crowd are constant for the whole four minutes, so the only structure is the photographer's rhythm: a short burst, a pause, another burst. Eleven seconds is deliberately below the twenty-second hard-gap rule, so the gap alone cannot separate these and the cadence window has to.
labelled_by: PHASE-08 section 8 step 9, authored ground truth
